description: Scans worldbuilding files for unexamined assumptions — descriptions, vocabulary, and social structures that were imported rather than derived from the civilization's biology, cognition, and environment. Applies to ALL civilizations: alien species get checked for anthropomorphism; human civilizations in novel contexts get checked for assumptions imported from familiar Earth cultures. Use after writing civilization content, during civilization builds, or when user says "check for assumptions", "anthropomorphism audit", "assumption check", "is this too human", "derivation check", "cultural assumption audit", or "did I import this". Reports only — does NOT fix content.
